# CopyButton

A button that copies a text to the clipboard. It only writes to the clipboard and never reads from it.

**Interaction**: hover and press add the shared state layer, `Tab` focus shows the focus ring and `Enter` /
`Space` copy. After copying, the icon turns into a check mark for 2 seconds, the tooltip says "Copied" and
screen readers announce "Copied". When copying fails, the icon turns into a warning sign for 4 seconds, the
tooltip and the announcement say "Couldn't copy", and `onError` is called. The width of the button with a
label does not change.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Copying tokens, links, IDs and code examples

## Import

```ts
import { CopyButton } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

An icon button with a tooltip next to the text it copies. After copying, the icon turns into a check mark.

```tsx
import { CopyButton, Inline, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={2} align="center">
      <Text mono size="sm">
        proj_01HZX4
      </Text>
      <CopyButton text="proj_01HZX4" label="Copy ID" size="sm" />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### With a label

`showLabel` shows the label next to the icon, for a copy action that deserves a button of its own.

```tsx
import { CopyButton } from 'vellum-ui'

export function WithLabel() {
  return <CopyButton showLabel text="https://example.com/share/r8Kd2" label="Copy link" />
}
```

## States

### Handling failures

Copying fails without a secure context (HTTPS) or when the browser refuses; the button shows the failed state
and `onError` receives the error.

```tsx
import { CopyButton } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Failure() {
  return (
    <CopyButton
      showLabel
      text="secret"
      onError={(error) => {
        // Report the error to your monitoring, or show a message
        console.warn(error)
      }}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | The text to copy. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `string` | Label: the text of the button with `showLabel`, otherwise the tooltip and the accessible name. "Copy" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | Shows the label next to the icon (a Button); by default only the icon is shown (an IconButton with a tooltip). | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | Size of the icon-only button: `sm` inside code blocks and list items, `md` in toolbars. | `'md'` | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables the button. | — | No |
| `onCopy` | `(text: string) => void` | Called after the text has been written to the clipboard. | — | No |
| `onError` | `(error: unknown) => void` | Called when copying fails: the Clipboard API is not available (it requires a secure context, HTTPS or localhost) or the browser refused to write. The button shows the failed state either way; without `onError` the error is reported with `reportError`. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
